Include cool movies. and to claim your tycoon you can't choose your one at start of the game I want a menu screen play and a cool background when u press play u have to spin a wheel and you get whatever movie you land on. and the graphics have to be outstanding. and for every put there franchise logo and home logo so players no where is base. the rest I want perfect replica of a tycoon and also make it so when you level up each movie base gets there own special powers and weapons which people can fight eachother with. answers.ask: Assumed district scale, 500-2000 studs, to hold ten bases plus an obby - should bases be walking distance apart or a drive?
answers.answer: Keep all bases within walking distance on a compact free-roam map; players should be able to reach other bases and the obby easily without needing vehicles.

answers.ask: The named franchises are licensed material - should the bases be recognisable homages built from generic parts instead?
answers.answer: Yes, use recognisable movie-inspired homages made with generic original parts, rather than direct licensed characters, assets, or exact replicas.

answers.ask: How many bases exist - exactly ten to match the server, or a larger wheel of franchises with unclaimed ones sitting empty?
answers.answer: Make exactly ten bases, one for each player slot, with the wheel assigning a movie-themed base when the player presses Play.

answers.ask: Is there a win condition, or is this an endless build-and-fight loop?
answers.answer: This is an endless tycoon build-and-fight loop with leveling, PvP bounty, auras, and upgrades; there is no final win condition.

scene_prompt: Create a compact free-roam 3D Movie Tycoon district with exactly ten separate, walkable movie-inspired tycoon bases arranged around shared central paths, all within easy walking distance. Build each base as a distinct original homage using generic parts, with a clear themed entrance marker and a home/base emblem so players can identify its territory; include visual themes such as a jungle dinosaur enclosure with heavy gates, a superhero city block, and other varied cinematic sets without direct licensed characters or exact replicas. Place a reachable obby course somewhere in the shared map, and a giant statue of the creator as a landmark. Keep the map polished and visually striking, with bases, paths, and the obby clearly visible in the free-roam composition.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation, specifically a tycoon, with Obby & Platformer secondary because the shared district contains a playable obstacle course. Simulation owns the overall shape and route.

## Shape and preset
Use `plot-isolated` for exactly ten independently themed player bases gathered into one compact district. Match the Tycoon preset, but substitute its shared plot with isolated per-player plots and omit its central upgrade bazaar because the brief specifies identifiable individual territories rather than one communal business.

## Config requirements
Use `gate-progression` as physical upgrade gates within each tycoon base and `path-circulation` as short shared walkways linking all ten bases. Add `path-track` for a physics-legal obby chain and `obstacle-jump` for its jump sequence. Draw the safe pads of `checkpoint-respawn`. Also draw ten distinct entrance markers and home emblems, the dinosaur-enclosure and superhero-city homages, other original cinematic sets, and one giant creator statue landmark.

## Layout requirements
Place the functional side of `checkpoint-respawn` at the obby start and after each substantial obstacle section, with respawn orientation facing the next jump. No other invisible placement is required.

## Layout components
Arrange exactly ten equal base plots in a compact ring or paired rows around a shared central path network, all within easy walking distance. Give every plot a visible themed gateway and emblem; include one gated jungle enclosure and one stylized superhero city block without licensed characters or copied assets. Put the obby along one outer edge, connected directly to the central paths and visually separate from plot entrances. Place the single giant statue at the central landmark node. Use level paved ground, clear plot borders, and a contained district boundary. Frame every base, the obby, and statue together.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: establish the district plan and valid obby sequence first, then dress it isometrically, because an impossible jump chain would make the course unplayable.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use a large scale band for ten bases plus a shared obby, while preserving compact walking distances. The theme is polished cinematic backlot spectacle with varied original genre homages. Route through `P6` because `path-track` must be valid by construction.
